name: rescript-platform
description: Rescript — professional survey programming & runtime platform

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' build && pnpm --filter @rescript/runtime build && pnpm --filter @rescript/studio build
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm audit:code
scripts.audit:code: node scripts/auth-guard-audit.mjs && node scripts/dependency-boundaries.mjs --self-test && node scripts/dependency-boundaries.mjs
